title: Accounting and Tax Services for Osteopaths

rows.before: We separated her treatment fee-split from her chair-rental income and booked each correctly, then incorporated a standard business corporation and modelled the move in on a section 85 rollover, taxing active income at 12.2% on the first $500,000 under the small business deduction and building a salary-and-dividend mix tested against the TOSI rules.
rows.after: We separated her treatment fee-split from her chair-rental income and booked each correctly, then incorporated a standard business corporation and modelled the move in on a section 85 rollover, taxing active income at 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) on the first $500,000 under the small business deduction and building a salary-and-dividend mix tested against the TOSI rules.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

page_note: All 12.2% occurrences are in case-study cards; no JSON-LD, meta or calculator occurrences. No 3.2%, 0.122, 0.032 or $600K found.
